title: TAPPaaS Positions
description: config/positions.json — where the site's hardware is inside its locations: the rooms (each in a location of site.json), the racks, every placement, the devices and the cables nothing can see. Site state, written only by position-manager. A placement is keyed by the device's name in the physical topology (a node, a switch, an access point, a machine, a device recorded here); the device's own record is never touched. A cable between two devices the switches or LLDP already see is not recorded here: the topology draws it. An absent file is an empty one.

placements.description: Where each device stands, keyed by the device's name: in a rack at its units, or loose in a room (no rack, no unit). A device has at most one placement. A passive device nothing records (a PDU) by its own name.

cables.description: Cables nothing can see: the ISP hand-off, a patch panel, a PDU; and the segments of a link split at a patch panel. A port carries at most one cable, a patch panel's port one on its front and one on its rear.

devices.description: The devices nothing manages (a modem, an ONT, a UPS, a patch panel, a device a switch port saw), keyed by name: a device like the topology's, placeable and a cable end.

rooms.description: The rooms, keyed by name: where racks stand and devices stand loose. Each is in a location of site.json.

name.description: The rack's name: lower case, digits and dashes. It is the record's key.
name.changeNote: The placements name the rack: add a rack under the new name, move the devices, delete the old one.

displayName.description: The name shown on the rack's frame.

units.description: The rack's height in rack units (U).
units.changeNote: Refused while a device would no longer fit.

width.description: The rack's width: a 19-inch rack, or a 10-inch one.

numbering.description: How the rack's units are numbered: U1 at the bottom (bottom-up), or at the top (top-down).
numbering.changeNote: Renumbers every device's position as drawn; the recorded U of each placement stays.

room.description: The room the rack stands in: a room record's name (position-manager room add). Text naming no room yet is kept as it is, with a note.

description.description: What the rack is for, in a line.

device.description: The placed device: its name in the physical topology. It is the record's key.
device.changeNote: A placement is one device's: unplace it and place the other device.

rack.description: The rack it is mounted in. A device loose in a room has none.

u.description: The lowest rack unit it occupies, as the rack numbers its units. A device loose in a room has none.

room.description: For a device in no rack: the room it stands loose in. A device in a rack is in its rack's room.

height.description: In a rack: how many rack units it occupies.

width.description: In a rack: how much of its width it takes, all of it, a half or a third.

slot.description: For a half- or third-width device: its column, 0 at the left.

face.description: In a rack: the side it faces.

faceplate.description: The faceplate drawn for it, from the catalog (vendor/model). Unset: the catalog's suggestion for the device's model, else a generic plate.

label.description: The label on the device, drawn on its plate.

description.description: A note on where it stands.

device.description: A device of the topology, a recorded device, a placed device, or one this cable places (with its faceplate).

port.description: The port, as the device's faceplate or the topology names it.

faceplate.description: For a device only this cable places (the ISP's modem): its faceplate.

side.description: On a patch panel's port: its front (the default) or its rear.

from.changeNote: Remove the cable and add it again.

to.changeNote: Remove the cable and add it again.

origin.description: A segment of a link split at a patch panel (cable split): what the link was — one the topology sees, or a recorded cable that cable join records again.

name.description: The device's name: how its placement and cables name it. It is the record's key.
name.changeNote: Its placement and cables name it: record the new one, move them, remove this one.

model.description: Its plate in the faceplate catalog (vendor/model); its ports come from it unless given.

ports.description: Its ports by name (a patch panel: 1 to N).

description.description: What it is, where it comes from.

location.description: The location it is at: a location of site.json (site-manager location list). Unset: the primary location. Its placement's room must be at the same location.

mac.description: The MAC address a switch port saw it by (device record): the topology knows it by it, and shows it as recorded rather than seen.

name.description: The room's name: how racks and placements name it. It is the record's key.
name.changeNote: Racks and placements name it: add the new room, move them, delete this one.

location.description: The location the room is in: a location of site.json (site-manager location list). Unset: the primary location.
location.changeNote: Refused while a device placed in the room records another location of its own.
